Title: Suresh's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Suresh - 33 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Sunita - 64 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Vikram - 59 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Sanjay - 32 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
5. Anita - 36 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The forest - tall trees, thick bushes

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Suresh stands in the living room. Sunita and Vikram stand near him.]

Suresh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Suresh pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Suresh: "What next?"

[Suresh sips red wine.]

Vikram (excited): "Sunita, listen!"

[Suresh staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Suresh (surprised): "What happened?"

[Suresh and Mother clink their glasses.]

Suresh (softly): "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The forest - Day

[Suresh stands in the forest. Sunita and Sanjay stand near him.]

Suresh: "What a nice place."

[Suresh goes hunting and aims his bow at a deer.]

Sanjay: "Oh wow!"

[Suresh rides an elephant through the forest.]

Suresh: "That was such a fun day!"
